Check Engine SEO 1.3.163

**Check Engine is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes) to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A speed result that was not measured no longer looks like a perfect one.* The Speed & Core Web Vitals area uses Google PageSpeed Insights. When that service did not run (it refused the request because of its shared quota, was switched off, or failed), the app used to show the area as clean, and the score counted it as 100. Now the area says "Not measured: PageSpeed Insights did not run" (with the recorded reason), in the app, the free result, the HTML and PDF reports, the command line and the data the AI assistants receive.
- *Your overall score can differ from before when PageSpeed Insights did not run.* An area with no speed problems found by the other checks is left out of the average instead of counting as 100, so the score can be lower than it used to be for the same site. If that area did find problems, it keeps its score and carries a note that Core Web Vitals are not in it. When PageSpeed Insights runs, nothing changes. Reports you saved earlier are not rewritten.
- Nothing else changed in how audits, reports or licences work. Your licence key, settings and past reports carry over as before.

99 checks across 13 areas.
